title: Transaction conditional references
name: TransactionConditionalReferences
description: A transaction's conditional references (Practitioner?identifier=...) resolve to the one resource their search matches, and the transaction fails when they match none, match several, or are not a valid search. Uses a Synthea patient, loaded after the organizations and practitioners it refers to. See https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/http.html#trules.

test.description: The transaction fails when the search matches no resource.
